featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience. The platform makes P2P lending look safe and predictable, but the reality is very different. Returns are far below expectations, repayments are inconsistent, and once borrowers start defaulting, recovery becomes uncertain.

What’s most concerning is that even so-called “conservative” portfolios are not immune - capital itself can be at risk. Initial payouts may create a false sense of comfort, but long-term performance tells another story. Support responses are unhelpful and even they don't have visibility into when they'd be able to recover the funds.

Strongly advise staying away from this platform, and from P2P lending in general, unless you fully understand the default and capital-loss risks involved.
